result.summary: Found 3 issues: two major layout/content truncation problems and one minor duplicate content issue.

issues.description: The third restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' section is cut off — both the image and the restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu...' are truncated at the right edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Implement a horizontal scroll indicator or ensure the card peek is intentional with a visible scroll affordance. The restaurant name should not be clipped — use ellipsis or ensure enough space is allocated.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Smash Bros Bu' is abruptly cut off without ellipsis, making the content unreadable and unprofessional.
issues.suggestion: Apply text overflow ellipsis (e.g., 'Smash Bros Bu...') or expand the card width to accommodate the full name.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' section shows 'Green Bowl Poké' listed twice with identical delivery time (15–25 min) and price (€0.90), which appears to be a duplicate entry.
issues.suggestion: Verify the data source to ensure unique restaurant listings are shown. If these are two different locations, differentiate them with branch names or addresses.
